inpost-notify-buyer.title: Choose when the marketplace is told "shipped"
inpost-notify-buyer.tourBody: The marketplace is told "shipped" either shortly after the label is bought or only after you click "Mark dispatched". This applies to this InPost account.
inpost-notify-buyer.viewBody: Here you set when the marketplace is told "shipped" after an InPost label is bought.
inpost-notify-buyer.why: Buying a label does not mean the parcel has been handed over, so by default the marketplace is told "shipped" only after you click "Mark dispatched". If you prefer, it is told shortly after the label is bought.

packing-owner.title: Say whether another system packs parcels
packing-owner.tourBody: Choose who packs orders that arrive in this system. This changes only what OpenLinker shows. Nothing gets blocked.
packing-owner.viewBody: Here you set who packs orders from this shop: OpenLinker or another system. It only changes what you see in OpenLinker.
packing-owner.why: If an external warehouse system packs the orders, tick "This system packs and ships orders itself". OpenLinker then hides its own "Mark as packed" button.

shipping-routing.title: Check who ships each delivery method
shipping-routing.tourBody: Every delivery method has a sender assigned. Check the list, fix what is wrong, then save on the page.
shipping-routing.tourTitle: Who ships parcels from this channel?
shipping-routing.viewBody: Here you can see who ships orders for each delivery method of this channel. Open Mappings, Fulfilment tab.
shipping-routing.why: Go to Mappings, Fulfilment tab. Check who ships each delivery method of this channel, fix the assignments and save.
